sentences.japanese: 万難を排して君の味方をしよう。
sentences.english: I'll stand by you through thick and thin.

sentences.japanese: 万難を排してやり遂げよう。
sentences.english: I will do it at all costs.

sentences.japanese: 少年たちは「万難を排して決行しましょう」と言った。
sentences.english: The young men said that they would do it despite all of the difficulties.

sentences.japanese: 彼は困難を排して進んでいった。
sentences.english: He made his way through difficulties.

sentences.japanese: 車の排ガスは有毒である。
sentences.english: Exhaust gases of a car are noxious.
